findings.before: Success returned before timer/owner checks, permitting simultaneous late exit/EOF acceptance.
findings.after: Deadline/owner checked before normal success and again after log fsync.

findings.before: Inherited recv_frame timeout reset on each recv; accepted socket not explicitly closed by broker.close.
findings.after: One absolute mono deadline spans header+payload, exact live peer is checked before HELLO bytes, accepted socket is shut down on close.

findings.before: Resource object validated its own binding while a caller supplied the separate HELLO domain/device/worker tuple.
findings.after: Before placement reservation, exact ResourceDomain type/SHA and run/manifest/worker/stage/device/lease/images/owner/supervisor fields are joined; domain deadline covers the parsed immutable job deadline.

reviewed_positive: Sealed fixed launcher, worker and job bytes prevent path replacement from selecting executed content.
PREEXEC launcher image and POSTEXEC worker image are distinct and share the bound process identity.
REAPED closes domain before internal exit release; store, source and deadline checks remain, and the closed domain is not incorrectly polled again.
Unknown/nonzero/partial exit or log results cannot release worker or advance stage.
Signals only address exact owned launcher or forked child pidfds; no numeric-PID or process-group kill fallback.
remaining_specific_limits: Kernel cgroup operation body is permanently denied and not executed; no actual memory/pids enforcement or atomic domain clone is proved.
CPU external GPU lease, free-VRAM and delegation flags are explicitly synthetic.
Native host peak and physical placement are not measured; all261native numerical checks remain NOT_RUN.
PIDfd SIGKILL delivery is not a bound on GPU completion or uninterruptible kernel I/O; unconfirmed exit must remain stopped/uncertain.
A full CPU fault suite tests one fixed worker path, not the72-request native qualification panel.
note: Resolved findings are source conclusions. Current full-chain14-case receipts, timer-boundary and partial-frame tests are separately supplied by the implementing agents; this review does not claim to have run them.
